_note: Every number used for computing income and hardware cost, with its source. Read by scheduler/pricing.py.

usd_chf.source: USD/CHF mid-market, about 0.83-0.84 on 11-14 Nov 2026 (Trustnet, xe.com)

reference_server.why: A dual EPYC 9654 server draws 1.0-1.2 kW at the wall under full load, so it is the case's 1 kW reference server.

cloud_same_server.instance: AWS c7a.48xlarge (192 AMD EPYC Genoa cores), eu-central-1 Frankfurt, Linux
cloud_same_server.source: AWS EC2 pricing via devzero.io instance page (spot price moves; checked Nov 2026)

embed.service: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 on Bedrock

tokens_per_abstract.source: measured: mean MiniLM tokens of the 5,183 SciFact abstracts as we embed them (truncated at 256)

rerank_docs_per_query.source: our job definition: 50k queries x 100 candidates = 5M pairs

hardware.source: Listed dual EPYC 9654 server, 512 GB DDR5: USD 23,028 = CHF 19,300 (AVADirect). Plus about 30% for 2026 memory prices (server DRAM roughly doubled since Q1 2025, Counterpoint) and water cooling: our estimate.

sell_price.why: Our compute pauses when the heat is not needed, like AWS spot capacity, so we price it like spot: the cautious choice.
